title: DenoiseMamba
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: Input projection
description: 1x1 Conv1d; transpose into a temporal token sequence.

nodes.title: Begin repeated Mamba block
description: LayerNorm and input projection split features into signal and gate.

nodes.title: Signal and selective scan
description: Parallel affine scan with input-dependent state parameters.
The scan includes its learned D shortcut.

nodes.title: Gate branch
description: Apply SiLU to the projected gate features.

nodes.title: Gate and residual update
description: Multiply scan output by the SiLU gate.
Dropout and linear projection; add the block input.

nodes.title: Output projection
description: After all configured blocks: LayerNorm, transpose and 1x1 Conv1d.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

edges.label: Block input; repeated for each block

notes: Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain configuration-dependent.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
The split, scan, gate and residual update form one block; that block repeats according to the configuration.
